_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The score has moved ±2+ points in 0 of 52 windows — this is a statistically confirmed coil, and neither brain has identified a live breaker (ETF inflows resuming or VIX >22 sustained) sufficient to claim a directional move.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing 0-for-18 base rate; narrative implies a bullish squeeze setup but does not explicitly call direction, creating an asymmetry where the structural bullish divergence is noted but not acted upon.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows spike >40 with funding >0.01% and BTC breaks $68K — forces phase up to Denial (rung 4); OR stablecoin growth accelerates further while F&G reclaims 32+.
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF outflows accelerate sustained negative with BTC losing $60K support on volume and VIX >22 — forces phase down to Capitulation (rung 2).
